title: Shiraishi An — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Plaza

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, without further ado, let's get our main event started!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Give it up for An's Birthday Bash Battle of the Bands!

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're calling it a battle of the bands because you'll form pairs and compete on stage!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: The rest of us will vote on which pair did better. The winners get to keep singing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So the winning pair stays on stage and competes against the next pair too. I see.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And whoever's left standing at the end is the winner. Sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We haven't had a good competition in a long time! I'm fired up!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Could it be that this event was inspired by Shiraishi's request?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know, I just wanna belt it out on stage!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Today you can sing on stage as much as you want, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Rin...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks so much! I'll give you my best performance ever!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, let's decide the pairs. If everyone could draw a straw...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, that's the pairs set!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me and Miku, huh! Let's win this!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm counting on you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: First up, we have MEIKO and Luka versus Akito and Len!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ooh, not bad!
Let's go, Akito! You got this, Len!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're not letting up the pressure for a second.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a strong contrast to MEIKO and Luka's mellow and soulful performance.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shinonome feels different from when we practice. He looks like he's having so much fun, too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! That was improv, right?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're really good at that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh maaan, I wanna sing right now!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha! You're so fidgety!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Come on, sit still already. It's your turn next.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And now, the time has come to crown the rulers of the stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Kohane and Rin have defeated all challengers so far!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But will they be victorious against the final pair of An and Miku?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's do this, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. Let's have a good match, An!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're up first. I'm good whenever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Same here. Let's go full power from the start. No holding back.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Everyone's performances were great...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (They reached right into my chest and grabbed my heart.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can't show them any less. I want to sing better than any of them!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, I can't just want it. I'll do it!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm not backing down, either.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Finally, the moment we've all been waiting for: the results!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which pair will be the rulers of the stage? The votes are in...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah...! At 3 to 3... It's a tie!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Aw man, a tie? Here I thought we'd win by a landslide.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too. But... What an exciting match!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It was amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whew, it's been a while since we turned up the heat like that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That was so much fun! It's so great just singing your heart out on stage!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks again, everyone. Getting my wish granted made this the best birthday ever!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm so glad to hear it! Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you know, I don't think I'm done singing just yet.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, just look at this amazing stage! Isn't it kind of a waste to be done already?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True, you make a good point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, welcome to free singing time, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh, nice!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, I'll sing some of An's favorite songs, then!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, whoa! How about letting the birthday girl go first?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, then... Can I sing with you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We faced off earlier, so now I'd like to sing by your side... Would that be okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Of course! Let's have everyone listen to our song!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An. I was so surprised when you replied to my birthday message with like three times as many messages.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I was surprised too. I didn't think she'd be that happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe, we sent so many messages back and forth!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But just texting doesn't feel like enough of a celebration... Let's do something special when you get back home to Japan!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An! It sounds like you had a good birthday in the US. I'm glad to hear it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It sounds like you had a delicious feast. But you must be starting to miss Japanese food by now, I'd think?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: When you get home, maybe we can celebrate your birthday at a nice Japanese restaurant.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, that sounds lovely. Okay, Airi and I will find a nice place to take you to.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiraishi! I'm told that Azusawa performed her very own show at your party.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Kohane said it went really, really, really well☆
I'm so glad I could help!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Well, we can't let her show us up, can we?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Indeed. When you get home, Shiraishi, we'll put on a special birthday show of our own!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, I'll do my best to make sure you enjoy it. And everyone seems really motivated... So look forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Happy birthday, An!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Did my message arrive right on time at midnight? I planned it out with the time difference and everything!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Shiraishi. I heard from Mizuki that you had a very fun birthday. A feast, performances, and even a singing battle?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Having a singing contest on your birthday sounds very like you, Shiraishi. I'm sure your performance was powerful.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd love to hear you guys perform again sometime. Happy birthday, and I hope this is a great year for you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday again, An.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That was our first competition in a while, and it was certainly thrilling. I'm glad you enjoyed your party so much, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'll say. She kept on singing way after the contest. If we hadn't wrapped things up, I bet she'd still be up there.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She couldn't stop talking about it even after we went back to our hotel rooms. She was like, “That performance was seriously the best!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: She was just that immersed in the music, I suppose. I could feel the same happening to me, just from watching her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Our next target's on the horizon now, after all. I'd say that kind of energy's just what we need.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's keep giving it our all, An...as we work toward our dream!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for all the birthday wishes, everyone!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It was so great getting to celebrate so much with my team! It really reminded me how much fun it is to sing up on stage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Maybe that's why I feel so fired up right now. We've got a super-big goal lined up, and all I feel is excitement!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Don't you dare miss the moment we stand on top of the world! I'll see you all there!
